caption_L1: This is a bar chart named Chile : Budget balance between 2015 to 2025 in relation to GDP. The x-axis plots Year using categorical scale starting at 2015 and ending at 2025* while the y-axis shows Budget balance in relation to GDP with categorical scale from −0.08 to 0.00.
caption_L2L3: The Chilean budget balance in relation to GDP is always in negative. It starts at around -0.02 in 2015 and stays relatively steady, with some increase, and then some decrease. However in 2020 there is a huge increase in budget balance in relation to GDP, up to nearly -0.09.  it then drops down, but not to the previous level over the next 5 years, until by 2025 it is lower than at the start of the measurement period.
